description: Comprehensive cross-app plumb: 6 pairs (figlet↔figlet, contour→figlet, figlet→journal, contour→journal, figlet→terminal, plasma→figlet) all pass. 90/90.

Baseline: audio-reactive-overlay with 5 effects (bass pulse, mid wave, treble sparkle, freq tint, edge glow). Shader barely visible — effects too subtle, screenshot captured full desktop not Ghostty window. Need stronger effects + focused capture.

Plasma Aurora v3: bass-driven plasma field (warm reds), mid-driven aurora curtains (green/cyan/purple), treble electric sparks, frequency-adaptive edge glow. FFT bars clearly visible through shader. Dramatic visual improvement over baseline. Text readable but shader dominates dark areas heavily.

Synthwave CRT v4: barrel distortion, bass-driven scanlines, treble chromatic aberration, mid phosphor glow (pink/cyan), VHS jitter on bass hits, synthwave horizon gradient + perspective grid. Strong visual identity. Better text readability than plasma — effects enhance text rather than obscure.

Deep Ocean Bioluminescence v5: bass pressure waves (underwater text sway), mid-driven plankton blooms (6-layer teal/blue/green noise), treble jellyfish pulse rings (purple/pink), caustic light shimmer, depth gradient. Most visually striking — organic shapes with real depth. Text readable with underwater tint.
